_leia: Cartas frias prontas, escritas pelo maestro. O Apps Script do Vini (enviarCartasDoRepo) le este arquivo a cada 2h, envia com assinatura + CV + carta em PDF e guarda o id no REPO_ENVIADAS. Nunca edite uma carta ja enviada; para reenviar, crie id novo.

cartas.assunto: Senior Character Artist · Wingfeather Saga credit · stylized + grooming
cartas.texto:
Hi Stefan,

EyeCandyFilm's about page says "we are story driven, we want to know our characters and we can't help looking for perfection design wise". A studio that puts knowing its characters in the sentence that defines it is the room I want to work in, and you founded it, so this goes to you ☺️

I am Vini Cavalcanti, a Senior 3D Character Artist with more than ten years in stylized characters. On The Wingfeather Saga season 1 at Angel Studios I modeled and hand painted the show's characters. For almost five years at E-Line Media I have taken Endstar's hero characters from first sculpt into engine: sculpt, retopology, UVs, baking, hand painted and PBR texturing, look development and grooming in Houdini.

Your own projects, co-productions and service work in "a variety of styles" is the mix my portfolio was built for: a cast that reads at first glance, stays on model across a series, and animates cleanly on a television budget. Design perfection is a modeling problem as much as a drawing one, and that is the part I enjoy most.

If character or modeling work opens up on your side, I'd like to be on your list. And if someone else there is the right person for this, just point me and I will take it there.

I am ready to move for the role, and I would need visa sponsorship.

Best,
Vini Cavalcanti
Portfolio: https://www.artstation.com/viniciuscavalcanti
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vinicavalcnti/
Site: https://vinicavalcanti.com
